labels.reason: The body contains fitted PK-PD parameter summaries, including Clearance, Vol, transfer-rate constants, Vol CSF and bacterial growth/kill parameters. It also supplies animal, dosing, sampling and assay context. Concentrations are explicitly confined to an untranscribed figure, so this page does not supply concentration-time observations or measured bacterial-response records. Mean, Median and SD describe reported parameters; their presence does not establish individual records, a validated variability distribution, component eligibility or human predictivity. Requirement links identify supported input fields and context only; remaining gaps are retained in findings. Parameter units vary by row and are preserved in the parameter labels; no common unit is stated for the summary columns.

evidence.quote: Population PK-PD parameters, rabbit P. aeruginosa meningoencephalitis model

Male NZW rabbits 2.08-3.78 kg; 300 µL of 1 × 10^5 CFU/mL P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 injected intrathecally; meropenem 5, 10 and 30 mg/kg/dose q8h IV push (marginal ear vein) from 6 h after inoculation. Total duration of therapy not stated (Results refer to bacterial burden at 30 h after inoculation).
Serial sacrifice at planned times; rabbits per dose group not stated (Results: "A total of 51 rabbits" including controls for meropenem).

Plasma sampled at 0, 10, 15, 20, 30 min, 1, 2, 4 h (n = 36); CSF satellite rabbits at 10 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h (text n = 4 at 10 mg/kg and n = 8 at 30 mg/kg; Fig. 2B says n = 8). LC-MS/MS, LLOQ plasma 0.1 mg/L, CSF 0.01 mg/L.
Three-compartment model (central, peripheral, CSF), Pmetrics. Clearance and volumes are per animal (L/h, L). Concentrations are in Fig. 2 only (not transcribed). Protein binding not reported.
Text: "AUCCSF:AUCplasma of 14.3%". "an AUC:MIC of 42.57" refers to the hollow-fiber model, not to rabbits.

findings.reason: F0003:S4:T1:A3-A6 supply dose levels, route, schedule, sampling times, assay limits and a reported model structure, but A6 explicitly states that concentrations are in Fig. 2 only and are not transcribed. No concentration-time body values or experimental-unit identifiers are supplied. Sampling-time origin is not explicitly defined. This is partial input coverage, not an available observation dataset.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked concentration values, explicit sampling-time origin, study/group and sampling-unit mapping, relevant individual covariates and any potential holdout design from authorized evidence. Retain reported parameters independently; leave model selection, fitting and adequacy to the animal PK module.

findings.reason: Clearance is reported in L/h with Mean 3.409, Median 3.388 and SD 0.919 in A9:D9; A6 states that clearance is per animal and identifies Pmetrics and a three-compartment model. This supports an AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE literature-reported estimate only. Dose chemical basis, total/free concentration basis, complete input history and the precise interpretation of the reported SD are not established on this page.
findings.needed_material: If CL is selected, retain the estimate as LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED; clarify the missing definitions and reported estimation/uncertainty context before its intended downstream use.

findings.reason: A10 and A15 report Vol (L) and Vol CSF (L), and A6 states that volumes are per animal. Neither row is explicitly identified as Vss. Their values do not establish a Vss match or the exposure/moment inputs required to derive Vss.
findings.needed_material: If Vss is selected, obtain the source definition and compartment mapping of Vol and any traceable Vss estimate or independently available Vss inputs. Preserve Vol and Vol CSF under their printed names.

findings.reason: MI002 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at adequacy: Rabbit PK component eligibility. Rabbit records cannot yet be assigned a supported component role or an exploratory-only role. Available support includes the central/peripheral/CSF model description, transfer parameters, Vol CSF summaries and the reported AUCCSF:AUCplasma ratio; A6 explicitly withholds the underlying concentrations from this table. This label does not resolve the SC031 support decision.
findings.needed_material: At adequacy, evaluate the supplied support under DRQ10 and SC031 and record an explicit supported-component, exploratory-constraint or unresolved outcome with its evidence and limitations. Keep the dependent eligibility decision pending until that review.

findings.reason: MI014 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk: Support for individual PK variability. A defensible individual-variability basis for subsequent population predictions has not been established. The table reports Mean, Median and SD for fitted parameters, but does not define the underlying parameter distribution, contributing units or whether SD represents between-animal variability or estimation uncertainty. Serial sacrifice and satellite sampling do not establish individual trajectories.
findings.needed_material: During PK work, assess traceable reported variability and experimental units under DRQ09; distinguish parameter uncertainty from interindividual variability and record supported variability or the resulting limitation without manufacturing it from summaries.

findings.reason: A5 preserves text n = 4 at 10 mg/kg, text n = 8 at 30 mg/kg and Fig. 2B n = 8. Their precise sampling-unit and figure-group correspondence is unresolved. Plasma n = 36 and A4's total of 51 rabbits including controls must also retain their distinct scopes; they cannot establish rabbits per dose group.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the count definitions and source contexts. Preserve every printed count and association; do not sum, reconcile or assign them to parameter rows or individual animals.

findings.reason: A3 supplies 5, 10 and 30 mg/kg/dose q8h IV push starting 6 h after inoculation, but explicitly leaves total therapy duration unstated. Number of administered doses, complete administration times and chemical dose basis are not supplied. The 30 h bacterial-burden reference does not establish treatment duration.
findings.needed_material: Retain the printed regimen and unknown fields during preparation; obtain source-supported dose history and dose-basis clarification where required. Do not reconstruct administration counts or duration from the endpoint reference.

findings.reason: A6 explicitly states Protein binding not reported. Total versus unbound concentration basis is unspecified, and A7's CSF:plasma AUC percentage is a site-exposure ratio, not a binding fraction. This page supplies no binding or directly measured free-concentration match.
findings.needed_material: If an unbound endpoint is pursued, obtain applicable binding or direct free-concentration evidence through the authorized input assessment; preserve independently supported reported parameters and do not assume fu equals one.

findings.reason: A3 supplies an actual study weight range and infected male NZW rabbit context; A6 states per-animal clearance and volumes. Individual weights and their links to the reported parameters are not supplied. The range supports candidate study metadata, not a selected scaling weight or qualified species contribution.
findings.needed_material: Before body-size translation, review whether the actual study weight evidence supports the specifically considered approach and obtain any required parameter-to-weight correspondence. Do not substitute a typical weight or compute a representative weight here.

findings.reason: A3-A5 supply organism/strain, inoculum, intrathecal infection, host descriptors, treatment-start interval and dose variation at a stated q8h interval. They do not supply measured response records, untreated growth-control values, strain MIC measurements or traceable regimen-exposure-response pairs. Treatment duration and response reference point remain incomplete. No dosing-frequency variation is shown on this page.
findings.needed_material: For response-linked work, obtain source-supported matched response, MIC, control and exposure inputs with endpoint definitions and treatment duration. Review design separation and any PK-transfer assumptions downstream; keep ranking unresolved if the design cannot separate candidate indices.

findings.reason: A16:A21 contain published fitted PD parameters. A7 separately identifies AUC:MIC 42.57 as belonging to the hollow-fiber model, explicitly not rabbits. These values identify reported source material; they do not establish rabbit exposure targets or primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the rabbit fitted parameters and hollow-fiber statement with their separate contexts. Ensure the independent index-analysis review enforces R14 and retains organism, infection-site and endpoint distinctions.
